snippet.title: Jaafar Jackson Tours Michael Jackson's Home Studio at Hayvenhurst | Michael Movie BTS
snippet.description:
Jaafar Jackson inside Michael Jackson's personal home recording studio at Hayvenhurst Estate, Encino, California! This official Behind The Scenes clip from the 2026 Michael biopic movie shows Jaafar immersing himself in his uncle Michael Jackson’s creative sanctuary. 

The real Hayvenhurst home studio is where Michael recorded early demos for iconic albums including the Thriller era. Because the actual room was too small for filming, the production team meticulously recreated it on a soundstage, faithfully including the vintage reel-to-reel tape recorder, large mixing console, John Lennon inspirational quote on one wall, and Thomas Edison motivational quote on another — details confirmed from Michael’s real studio that inspired his dedication and practice.

Jaafar rehearsed and even slept at Hayvenhurst to deeply absorb Michael Jackson’s energy and legacy. A true temple of creativity and perfection! ❤️

snippet.title: Michael Jackson - Beat It (Original Home Vocal Demo)
snippet.description:
Michael Jackson recorded the original home vocal demo for "Beat It" in 1982 at his Hayvenhurst home studio during the Thriller album sessions.

In this demo, Michael Jackson performed the lead vocals, harmonies, and the entire rhythm using beatboxing and layered vocals to show producers how the track should sound. Quincy Jones had requested a rock song with a strong message, and he liked the demo immediately. It helped shape the final studio version, which later featured Eddie Van Halen's guitar solo.

The demo was officially released on the "This Is It" album in 2009 and also appeared on "Thriller 40" in 2022.

snippet.title: Michael Jackson's Attorney Responds to New Netflix Docuseries on Piers Morgan
snippet.description:
In this powerful interview on Piers Morgan Uncensored, Michael Jackson’s legendary defense attorney Thomas Mesereau speaks out and explains exactly why he refused to participate in Netflix’s latest docuseries "Michael Jackson: The Verdict."

Mesereau states clearly:
"He was completely exonerated... the case is CLOSED. Michael was found NOT GUILTY!"

He also called the timing highly suspicious — releasing this right after the massive global success of the Michael biopic, when fans worldwide are celebrating the King of Pop’s music, dance, and incredible legacy once again.

Michael Jackson was innocent. A humble, kind-hearted man with a pure love for children and humanity. As fans, we will always stand for the truth and protect his beautiful legacy. It’s time to honor the innocent artist he truly was and let his music and magic live on forever. 🕊️❤️

snippet.title: Michael Jackson Fan Event Tokyo 2026 | Rich + Tone & Kento Mori Live in Kabukicho
snippet.description:
On May 9, 2026, over 400 Michael Jackson fans gathered at Kabukicho Cinecity Plaza in Shinjuku, Tokyo for a large-scale synchronized dance event.

This special gathering was organized as part of the official promotional activities for the theatrical release of the Michael movie in Japan.

Special Guests on Stage:
• Rich + Tone – Legendary choreographers who worked with Michael Jackson on the HIStory World Tour and contributed to the Michael movie choreography.
• Kento Mori – Renowned Japanese dancer who performed in Michael Jackson’s “This Is It” tour.
• Kaito Miyachika (Chaka) – Member of Travis Japan and Japan’s official Michael Jackson ambassador.

The event showcased the incredible energy and passion of Japanese fans as they celebrated Michael Jackson’s legacy together with the special guests.

Event Details:
📅 Date: May 9, 2026
📍 Location: Kabukicho Cinecity Plaza, Shinjuku, Tokyo, Japan
🎯 Purpose: Promotion for the Michael Movie Japan Release on June 12, 2026

The Legend Never Dies 👑🕺
